description: Use first when someone asks which data protection laws their organisation must follow (Swiss FADP/nLPD/DSG, EU GDPR, EU AI Act), for example a Swiss company selling online to the EU. Returns the core obligations that follow for that profile and those that only one of the two laws asks, each with the articles of each law and the template that carries it out. Tells whether the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP/LPD/DSG), the EU GDPR and the EU AI Act apply to an organisation, from five yes/no questions (GDPR art. 3 and AI Act art. 2 territorial scope included). The AI Act binds organisations established in the EU or whose AI output is used there; Switzerland has no AI law yet, but rules that keep staff from putting personal data into AI tools follow from the FADP and are good practice. Guidance, not legal advice.

ai.description: Uses AI systems in its work (AI assistants, chatbots, automated screening or scoring).

ch.description: Established in Switzerland, or processing data of people in Switzerland.

euEstablishment.description: Has an establishment (branch, subsidiary, office) in the EU/EEA.

euMonitoring.description: Monitors the behaviour of people in the EU/EEA (online tracking, profiling).

euOffer.description: Offers goods or services to people in the EU/EEA.

lang.description: Language of the answer: it, de, fr or en.
